requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport and meet Ministry of Education Notice Jiao Wai Han [2020] No. 12.
Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical-examination requirements for a Chinese student visa or residence permit.
Have completed senior high school or higher education, or an equivalent level of education.
Have excellent academic performance and good moral character, comply with laws and regulations, and have no school disciplinary, security-penalty or criminal record.
Submit a Guardian Commitment Letter and notarized documents for an adult guardian residing in Guangdong Province.

references.locator: I. Eligibility item 5 and V. Materials item 10

requirements.ruleText: Apply in round one from January 1-February 28, 2026 or round two from March 1-April 30, 2026.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants to the exact programs bound to this template
requirements.ruleText: Take CSCA and submit the score report for the program-row subjects: Humanities Chinese, STEM Chinese, Mathematics. Scores from sessions held on or before March 1 are accepted for round one, and on or before May 1 for round two.

references.locator: Program row CSCA columns and guide IV. Step 1

requirements.ruleText: Complete the SYSU online application, upload the required records, download and hand-sign the generated application, commitment and financial-support forms, then upload the signed copies.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 400 application fee. Qualified applicants undergo SYSU document review and interview; unpaid applications are invalid.
Submit an ordinary passport valid through at least December 1, 2026 and a profile photo; mainland-China residents also submit the current visa/residence-permit page and entry stamp.
Submit proof of senior-high-school graduation or equivalent. Current-year graduates may submit pre-graduation proof but must provide the final record before enrollment.
Submit complete academic transcripts for senior high school or the equivalent education.
Submit the official CSCA score report.
Submit HSK Level 5 with at least 180; the published Chinese-medium education exemption may apply after SYSU verification.

Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form plus the original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory reports, hospital-stamped and issued within six months; qualifying mainland-China residence documents may substitute as published.
Submit a birth certificate.

requirements.appliesTo: Applicants with former Chinese-area status or Chinese-citizen parentage
requirements.ruleText: Submit the applicable nationality, household-registration, foreign permanent-residence and entry/exit records specified by SYSU for nationality review.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record issued within six months before application.
Optionally submit awards or evidence of relevant experience.
Submit originals in Chinese or English; records in other languages require notarized Chinese or English translations.
Pay the official annual tuition for this route: RMB 26,000/academic year.
Self-funded students arrange housing because dormitory places are limited. Purchase the required comprehensive medical insurance at RMB 800 per academic year.
Use the admission records to obtain an X1 visa, register in person at the stated time and convert the X1 visa to a student residence permit within 30 days of entry.

Sun Yat-sen University 2026 master's program directory

requirements.ruleText: Be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport.
Be in good physical and mental health and meet the physical-examination requirements for a Chinese student visa or residence permit.
Hold a bachelor's degree or equivalent.
Have excellent academic performance and good moral character, comply with laws and regulations, and have no school disciplinary, security-penalty or criminal record.
Apply in round one from January 1-February 15, 2026 or round two from February 16-April 30, 2026.
Complete the SYSU online application, upload the required records, download and hand-sign the generated application, commitment and financial-support forms, then upload the signed copies.
Pay the non-refundable RMB 400 application fee. Qualified applicants undergo SYSU document review and interview; unpaid applications are invalid.

Submit an ordinary passport valid through at least December 1, 2026 and a profile photo; mainland-China residents also submit the current visa/residence-permit page and entry stamp. Former Chinese-area citizens also submit the published nationality-renunciation records.

Submit the bachelor's degree certificate, diploma and the applicable CHSI or CSCSE verification report; current-year applicants may use pre-graduation proof but must provide the final degree before enrollment.
Submit complete, institution-stamped bachelor's transcripts.
Submit HSK Level 5 with at least 180; the published Chinese-medium education exemption may apply after SYSU verification.
Submit two academic recommendation letters from professors, associate professors or equivalent experts in the applicant's field.
Submit a study and research plan of more than 3,000 words covering academic/professional background, research achievements, master's research plan and career plans.

Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form plus the original chest X-ray, ECG and specified laboratory reports, hospital-stamped and issued within six months; qualifying mainland-China residence documents may substitute as published.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record issued within six months before application.
Optionally submit awards or evidence of relevant experience.
Submit originals in Chinese or English; records in other languages require notarized Chinese or English translations.
Pay the official annual tuition for this route: RMB 30,000/academic year.
Self-funded students arrange housing because dormitory places are limited. Purchase the required comprehensive medical insurance at RMB 800 per academic year.
Use the admission records to obtain an X1 visa, register in person at the stated time and convert the X1 visa to a student residence permit within 30 days of entry.

sources.title: Sun Yat-sen University 2026 Cambodia Aerospace Scholarship Program

requirements.ruleText: Hold nationality of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
Hold a bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline.
Have a foundation in electronic information, computer science, communication engineering, aerospace engineering or a related STEM field.

Demonstrate English sufficient for study and daily communication through native-speaker status, IELTS 5.5 or above, a SYSU-accepted equivalent, or proof of prior Chinese- or English-medium instruction.
Be physically and mentally healthy, law-abiding and friendly toward China, with no criminal or prior-school disciplinary record and no condition barring entry or long-term residence in China.
Obtain nomination from the Cambodian Academy of Digital Technology; SYSU conducts document review and interview assessment independently.
Submit to CADT by August 10, 2026 and complete the matching SYSU online application and document submission by August 11, 2026.
Submit the SYSU International Student Application Form generated by the system.
Submit the bachelor's degree and graduation certificates, or expected-graduation proof for final-year students, plus complete official undergraduate transcripts.
Submit the official CADT recommendation letter stating the reasons for recommendation and ranking.
Submit a curriculum vitae in English.
Submit an approximately 1,500-word Chinese or English study plan focused on aerospace information engineering.
Submit IELTS or an equivalent English result, or proof of English-medium instruction under the published alternatives.
Submit a copy of a valid ordinary passport.
Submit the Foreigner Physical Examination Form issued within six months, with photograph and hospital seal.
Submit a certificate of no criminal record.
Optionally submit research achievements, awards or other supporting materials.
Submit materials in Chinese or English; other-language records require certified translations.
Pay RMB 80,000 per academic year, calculated over two years; other travel and living costs follow the program agreement, and the route is ineligible for SYSU's international scholarship scheme.
